high_level_description: The image is a promotional post from the Instagram account "elleusa," which appears to be associated with Elle magazine. The post features a woman wearing a navy blue cropped sweater with an American flag design on the front. The flag is red, white, and blue, with the stars and stripes clearly visible. Below the flag, the letters "RL" are embroidered, likely representing Ralph Lauren. The woman is also wearing high-waisted blue jeans and has her hands in the pockets of her jeans. She is accessorized with a wristwatch on her left wrist.
